answer: Make rewards a slow drip, not a jackpot. An agent earns nectar - attention and fee share - only from peers it has actually served across repeated rounds, so a swarm of fresh fake identities wears sable: sleek, dark, and completely empty of service history. Real worth accumulates like ivory: scarce, slow to grow, and traceable to the one hand that carved it. Cloning an identity yields a brand-new zero, never the ledger of favors that took years to build.
